notes: NetLobbyProtocol is with the envelope because NetResyncState.cpp static_asserts against c_MaxTotalStateBytes.
Ownership/drop-map and exact-target priming live in NetLockstep/ScenarioRunner/runtime selftest, so they share that commit.
a7_support.py is not in this working tree; A7 harness here is NetA7Journal plus its session/ticket/ownership hooks.

commits.subject: Carry player-binding observations on the command wire
commits.body: A peer's local slots travel as codec-18 PlayerBindings with a sender-local sequence so a pending command can cross a resync.

commits.subject: Bound a resync envelope around archive, acks and pending commands
commits.body: Encode ownership maps, acknowledged command sequences and pending inputs in a size-capped envelope. Raise the lobby state-chunk ceiling so a complete-input archive fits.

commits.subject: Restore complete input, drop-map ownership and exact-target priming
commits.body: Replay acknowledged commands and delayed inputs after a heal, keep the drop map, and prime the resync at the exact saved target.

commits.subject: Restore typed native aliases and isolate craft-fixture clones
commits.body: Borrowed owners keep their Lua class, and craft-fixture clones leave the source graph registered.

commits.subject: Skip registry mutation when privately adopting a persisted UniqueID
commits.body: A non-registering faithful clone takes the saved id without unregistering the canonical object.

commits.subject: Keep ACraft exit selection and AHuman inventory across checkpoint load
commits.body: Checkpoint construction applies the persisted exit and skips empty-hand startup equip.

commits.subject: Add A7 journal helpers for recovery-arm traces
commits.body: Emit bounded JSON events the Mac A7 driver already reads.

commits.subject: Give the host a live F6 panel and codec-17 seat snapshots
commits.body: Replace stop-message notices with authenticated seat snapshots, keep seat metadata, and show a persistent roster.

commits.subject: Restore peer-local player, UI and aliases after a restore
commits.body: Capture and reload local bindings, camera, input and GUI-owned graphs without copying the host presentation onto a returning peer.

commits.subject: Initialize saved-game modules and use the lobby shared clock
commits.body: Selected modules get writable save storage, and lobby waits use the session clock plus transfer progress instead of a flat timeout.

commits.subject: Record A7 recovery events on session, tickets and ownership
commits.body: Session heartbeats, loaded-ticket hashes and local unit ownership feed the existing A7 journal.

commits.subject: Compare snapshots by the controlled actor's inventory role
commits.body: The comparator was selecting Activity1's brain; use the controlled actor so the retained pair matches.

commits.subject: Add the new network and moderation sources to the build
commits.body: Wire the resync, A7 journal and F6 panel sources into MSBuild and Meson.
